goal: Prevent nodes from silently operating on corrupted storage when database reads or deserialization fail
Fail immediately on corrupt index and coin entries instead of masking corruption as missing data
agreement: Unaddressed objection: abrupt aborts break startup recovery and terminate kernel library hosts (furszy)
Contested objection: shutting down the node for corrupted optional indexes is too destructive (ajtowns)
Support for removing redundant view layers and simplifying error paths (andrewtoth)

categories.name: indexes
why: P2 because it prevents nodes from continuing to run on corrupted index storage
A corrupt index lookup currently fails an isolated RPC while the node remains running

categories.name: kernel
why: P3 because routing errors through kernel notifications is marginal while abort semantics remain disputed
Abrupt process termination inside database reads conflicts with embedding the library in external apps

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because it prevents storage corruption and deserialization failures from masquerading as missing coins
Eliminating masked read errors protects chainstate integrity and removes redundant view layers
